hibiscusfaultline.configuration.title: Hibiscus Faultline Settings
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.maxBlock: Most blocks one vein-mine can break, counting the block you broke yourself.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.maxDista: How far from the first block, in blocks, the selection can reach.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.hungerPe: Extra exhaustion for each additional block broken. Vanilla already adds 0.005 per block.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.cooldown: Ticks to wait between vein-mines. 20 ticks is one second.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.stopBefo: Stop mining when the tool has one point of durability left, so it never breaks.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.gatherDr: Drop everything at the block you broke instead of across the vein.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.dropsToI: With Gather Drops on, put drops straight into your inventory. Anything that doesn't fit drops at the block.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.mergeOre: Treat stone and deepslate versions of the same ore as the same block.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.mergeWoo: Treat logs and wood from the same kind of tree as the same block.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.shapedMo: Tunnel and square modes only take blocks that match the one you broke.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.requireT: Only vein-mine while holding a tool. When off, any item or a bare hand works.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.toolMust: Only take blocks the held tool is meant for, so a shovel skips stone and a pickaxe skips dirt.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.to: Choose which modes players can scroll to.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.sh: Every matching block connected to the one you broke.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.sm: A 1x1 line into the face you hit.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.mi: A 1 wide, 2 tall tunnel into the face you hit.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.la: A 3x3 tunnel into the face you hit.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.es: A 1 wide, 2 tall staircase going up and away from you.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.modes.sm: A flat 3x3 square on the face you hit.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.buildToo: The build tool slot to the right of the hotbar.
Let players use the build tool slot. The faultline.build.use permission can still turn it off per player.
Most blocks one build operation can cover in survival. The faultline.build.max_volume permission overrides it per player.
Most blocks one build operation can cover in creative.
How far from you, in blocks, a selection or destination can be in survival.
How far from you, in blocks, a selection or destination can be in creative.
Most blocks drawn as ghost blocks in a preview. Bigger operations show only their outline.
Most blocks an operation changes per tick, so big operations don't stall the server.
How long Erase takes per block in survival, as a share of mining it by hand with your best tool.
How many blocks Erase works on at once in survival.
Let Erase remove blocks you carry no tool to harvest. They drop nothing. When off they're skipped.
How many containers a player can link as extra material sources.
How far away, in blocks, a linked container still counts.
What happens to returned items that don't fit anywhere: drop them at your feet, or stop the operation.
Most copies one Stack can make.
Let Clone and Stack copy chest contents and machine state in creative. Off by default, so a creative-built chest can't be carried into survival full.
How many survival operations each player can undo.
How many creative operations each player can undo.
Most changed blocks kept for undo per player. Older operations are forgotten past it.
Moves the tool slot and its palette sideways, in pixels. Negative is left.
Raises the tool slot and its palette, in pixels.
How far the destination moves per block the gizmo is dragged.
The block Set fills with. The game fills this in; empty uses your offhand block.
Show where Move and Clone would put blocks as translucent ghost blocks.
Show the mouse button hints next to the build tool's name.
The build tool you used last. The game fills this in.
Each build tool's options. The game fills this in from the options panel.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.hudEnabl: Show the Faultline panel while the key is held.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.hudCorne: Which corner of the screen the panel sits in.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.hudOffse: Pixels between the panel and the left or right edge of the screen, on whichever side its corner is.
Pixels between the panel and the top or bottom edge of the screen. Raise it to clear other overlays such as an FPS counter.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.outlineC: Colour of the selection outline as RRGGBB hex, for example FFFFFF for white.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.remember: Start in the mode you used last instead of Shapeless.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.invertSc: Reverse which way the mouse wheel cycles through the modes.
hibiscusfaultline.configuration.lastMode: The mode you used last. The game fills this in; used when Remember Last Mode is on.
